nodes.label: Python function for calculating cosine similarity between two vectors
nodes.content_preview: # File: embedding_utils.py  import numpy as np  def cosine_similarity(v1: np.ndarray, v2: np.ndarray) -> float:     return float(np.dot(v1, v2) / (np.linalg.norm(v1) * np.linalg.norm(v2)))
